LESSON: PRANAYAM (BREATHING EXERCISES)

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: General
Strand: Yoga
Topic 6.1: Pranayam (Breathing exercises)

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Pranayam (Breathing exercises). Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Pranayam (Breathing exercises)
2. Practise Pranayam (Breathing exercises) at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Pranayam (Breathing exercises)

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Pranayam (Breathing exercises)
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Pranayam (Breathing exercises). Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Pranayam (Breathing exercises) at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Pranayam (Breathing exercises) at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Pranayam (Breathing exercises)
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Pranayam (Breathing exercises). Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Pranayam (Breathing exercises) using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Pranayam (Breathing exercises) in the examples.
2. Explain Pranayam (Breathing exercises) to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Pranayam (Breathing exercises).
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Pranayam (Breathing exercises) using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Pranayam (Breathing exercises) important for a Grade 4 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Pranayam (Breathing exercises)
2. Practise Pranayam (Breathing exercises) at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Pranayam (Breathing exercises)

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
